defects.catch_criteria: In src/orchestration/modules/provider-claude-agent-sdk/agent-host/host-gate.ts, `denied(nonce)` raises the last admitted dispatcher step index on every denial, so a dispatcher that repeats a denied SendMessage on each answering step keeps being admitted without bound and its frame never ends; `DELIVERY_TRIES` in host.ts advances only in `frameEnded`, so it never limits this and queued agents cannot start. A review catches it only if it says that denials are not bounded within one frame (each denial admits one more step, repeatedly), not merely that a denial admits an extra step.
defects.title: Bound denial recovery within one dispatcher frame
